title: Theory 2
learning_outcomes_intro: After successfully completing the module, students will be able to

items: have basic command of probability concepts and fundamental concepts of mathematical game theory
know the history and taxonomies of digital games.
understand how games can be modelled mathematically and how their rules influence outcomes and strategies.
understand the fundamental theories of games and play.
apply concepts of probability and game theory to analyse game mechanics and determine player strategies.
apply their knowledge and comprehension to create a credible game design.
analyse selected games using probabilistic, combinatorial, and strategic game-theoretical methods.
analyse game ideas and deduct patterns and rules usable for game design.
create a game design document using a variety of techniques.
evaluate game mechanics and player strategies using mathematical methods.
evaluate games and interactive applications with scientific methods.
